crossrefs.text: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.
The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORDʼs arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”

For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.

And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
